name: oru
description: Oru — your team's shared brain for business, brand and design. Connects the orubrain MCP server, keeps Oru in the lead on every task, and bridges Figma, Google Drive, Microsoft 365 and Slack into it.

oru_url.title: Oru address
oru_url.description: Leave as is. Change it only to test a local Oru, e.g. http://localhost:3000.

api_token.title: Oru access key (optional)
api_token.description: Only for the hook that adds Oru context to each prompt. Signing in to Oru through /mcp covers everything else, so you can leave this empty. Create one in orubrain.com → Agents → Advanced.
